[[File:Eddie Szwabowski BoardMatt 2025-01-05 still.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Eddie Szwabowski. Still: BoardMatt.]]
'''Eddie Szwabowski''' (GEMP and forum handle '''Nrabbit''')<ref name="org2022">Email from Stephen Sanders to Retro League participants, 2026 (player name / GEMP handle / forum name list for 2022).</ref><ref name="t86628">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86628 Nrabbit takes the train to San Diego - A Retro Tournament Report], Nrabbit, forum.starwarsccg.org (16 April 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012213842/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t86628.html Internet Archive].</ref> (also Edward Szwabowski) won the Sunday Retro event at the [[2026 San Diego Super Open]] undefeated.<ref name="wrap">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-san-diego-super-open-wrap-up-joe-olson-conquers/ 2026 San Diego Super Open wrap-up], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261011191508/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-san-diego-super-open-wrap-up-joe-olson-conquers.html Internet Archive]</ref> He publishes the Eddie YouTube channel and interviews players on twitch.tv/Nrabbit.<ref name="ch-eddie" /><ref name="yt-5j3uQRj6-jQ" />
